YQUP helps boards, CEOs and operators turn AI ambition into clear decisions, visible ownership and practical operating rhythm.

Bring the decision that is stuck.

  • What are you trying to decide?
  • What evidence would change the decision?
  • Who owns the outcome after the meeting?
  • Where must human judgement stay visible?

Make AI work visible enough to decide on.

The useful work is the clarity around ownership, risk, evidence, cost, cadence and what happens after the meeting.

01.

Know what is being approved

Name the outcome, risk, owner, cost and evidence before the work drifts through the organisation.

02.

Keep ownership visible

Make it clear who can proceed, who can stop, who reviews the result and where judgement belongs.

03.

Leave evidence behind

Ways to work.

YQUP is practical advisory for boards, CEOs and operators who need a clearer decision, a more honest operating picture or a calm outside view.

  1. 01.

    Board / CEO advisory

    For boards and CEOs who need to approve, stop, narrow, explain, fund, govern, or operationalise AI work without losing the decision trail.

  2. 02.

    Operating model review

    Review access, accountability, data boundaries, finance controls, workflow ownership, review rhythm, and escalation paths.

  3. 03.

    Decision and system-site build

    Design decision rights, rituals, and small public or controlled surfaces that make the owner, boundary, evidence, and next route clear.

  4. 04.

    Leadership workshop or town hall

    Align the team, surface concerns, and give leaders and operators a working language for outcomes, boundaries, evidence, and human judgement.

  5. 05.

    Ongoing advisory

    Regular support for leaders who need a calm outside view on progress, risk, governance, adoption, and the next useful decision.
